browserRss.scope: 250-ms OS RSS samples of only the owned acceptance runner's Chromium descendants, including browser, renderer and GPU processes. Sampled whole-browser high-water, not isolated worker retained allocation or an instantaneous peak. No user process was sampled or interrupted.

runtime-preview-01.scope: Fresh owned profile and the actual custom-model worker with a 24-cube synthetic pointwise oracle. Explicit WASM-only session; configuration read from its already-loaded ORT module after real completion. All listed runtime, pipeline and pinned model assets fetched and hashed in the page under the actual host policy. Offline blocks every other origin. Not anatomical, WebGPU performance, or arbitrary model admission proof.
